title: Discretionary-accruals models and audit qualifications
sources_checked: Resolved assigned catalog record: output/feasibility_reproduction/resources/catalog.json (work_item.catalog_path after project relocation), generated 2026-10-27; checked dataset paths, row counts, field names, types, and source metadata for all six declared inputs.

COMP.FUNDA — ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/funda.sas7bdat; 941,340 rows, file metadata last modified 2026-07-22; checked GVKEY, DATADATE, FYEAR and INDL/STD/C/D filters. Filtered rows include FY1998 12,554; FY1999 12,531; FY2000 12,093; FY2001 11,584; FY2002 11,253. FY2002 DATADATE spans 2002-06-30 to 2003-05-31. No added-window GVKEY-FYEAR duplicates.

COMP.SEC_MTH — ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/security/sec_mth.sas7bdat; 8,453,514 rows, file metadata last modified 2026-08-14; checked GVKEY/IID/DATADATE/PRIMISS; available dates span 1998-01-31 to 2003-12-31 and added-window GVKEY-IID-DATADATE keys are unique.

COMP.SEC_MTHPRC — ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_na/security/sec_mthprc.sas7bdat; 8,285,814 rows, file metadata last modified 2026-08-14; checked GVKEY/IID/DATADATE/CURCDM/PRCCM; available dates span 1998-01-31 to 2003-12-31 and added-window GVKEY-IID-DATADATE keys are unique.

COMP.G_EXRT_DLY — ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/comp/d_global/currency/g_exrt_dly.sas7bdat; 2,221,564 rows, file metadata last modified 2026-08-14; checked FROMCURD/TOCURD/DATADATE/EXRATD. The bounded GBP bridge scan found 369,497 positive daily quote rows across 1998-2003 and no duplicate DATADATE-TOCURD keys.

CRSP.CCMXPF_LINKTABLE — ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/crsp/a_ccm/ccmxpf_linktable.sas7bdat; 92,711 rows, file metadata last modified 2026-08-14; checked LINKPRIM/LINKTYPE/LPERMNO/LINKDT/LINKENDDT. The source has 11,922 eligible P/C, LC/LU/LS, positive-PERMNO links overlapping 1998-2002.

CRSP.DSENAMES — ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT}/crsp/a_stock/dsenames.sas7bdat; 117,859 rows, file metadata last modified 2025-12-06; checked PERMNO/NAMEDT/NAMEENDT/SICCD. 24,242 dated rows overlap the 1998-2002 event window under the expanded 2003-05-31 input bound; 24,227 have a valid SICCD.
changes: Extended the event-year fiscal label from 1980-1997 through 1980-2002 and the event population, first-qualified case selection, and cross-sectional Jones support through FY2002. Retained the 1971 start of historical accrual support and all original matching, common-sample, winsorization, and logit rules.

Widened the SEC_MTH, SEC_MTHPRC, GBP daily FX, and DSENAMES date filters through 2003-05-31, the maximum DATADATE observed among filtered FY2002 Compustat rows. This accommodates fiscal-label/reporting-date differences; the fit clock remains FYEAR and no event year after 2002 enters the sample.

Added active-fit Stata e(sample) counts for FY1980-1997 and FY1998-2002, computed the last added fiscal year during each fit, and saved one fresh aggregate esttab CSV per Table 7 model under work/artifacts/. The estimator and model terms were unchanged.

The pooled handoff contains 481 matched pairs (962 firm-event observations): 475 pairs/950 observations from FY1980-1997 plus 6 pairs/12 observations from FY1998-2002. The added pairs occur in FY1998, FY2000, FY2001, and FY2002; the last contributing year is FY2002.
limitations: Exact source match ordering, control replacement/ties, and historical Big Six crosswalk are not fully specified; the accepted construction uses disclosed deterministic rules.
Published Table 1 Big Six counts conflict (151/22 in the table versus 152/21 in the surrounding text); the construction does not force either split.
Table 3 cites income item 18 but labels it “income from operations,” while Table 7 says “income from continuing operations”; IB is used from the provider item-18 crosswalk.
Local Compustat and matched event-year currency conversion may differ from the authors’ vintage and sample; unavailable issue/date prices or FX rates remain missing.
CRSP SIC fallback is best-effort and is used only when FUNDA.SICH is missing; source overlaps contain both agreement and disagreement, so Compustat SICH is retained wherever available.
Price quote currency is directly observed only when the exact dated HIID issue price agrees with annual PRCC_F; FUNDA.CURCD is an explicitly inferred proxy for remaining price rows.

The source gives one Table 7 count (173 qualified and 173 unqualified) but not the exact joint missing-data or control-eligibility algorithm. The predecessor A2 common pre-match complete-data screen produced 475 pairs (475 per side; 950 rows), versus the published 173 per side. This replay yields 481 pairs; the source-vintage and sample-selection gap remains unexplained.

The five-year extension adds only 6 matched pairs (12 firm-event observations), in FY1998 and FY2000-2002; no added matched pair contributes in FY1999. The small added sample limits the weight of later years in the pooled fits.

SAS emitted narrow-variable-range and potentially inaccurate R-square warnings in some supporting PROC REG fits. The accepted full-rank and eight-prior-year screens remained in force; the final four logits completed, but the supporting-regression numerical warnings were not resolved.

The Stata template reports two-sided coefficient p-values, while Table 7 describes one-tailed slope probabilities; displayed p-values and stars therefore retain the predecessor’s convention difference.

analyses.label: Table 7 Time-Series Jones Model
analyses.reason: Fresh native Table 7 logit verified on the pooled FY1980-FY2002 matched event-year sample. The active Stata estimation sample includes 950 observations in FY1980-FY1997 and 12 observations in FY1998-FY2002; its last added period is FY2002. The 962 observations form 481 matched pairs.
source_evidence: work/work_item.json: model t7_ts_jones, result set t7_ts_jones_table7, sample qualified_audit173; Table 7 physical p. 21 (continued on p. 22), event years 1980-1997; the paper reports 173 qualified and 173 clean controls but no combined fit N.

work/design.md: cited article physical pp. 6-8 (Jones/Modified Jones equations and eight prior years), pp. 11-12 (first qualified opinions and matching), and pp. 20-22 (Table 7 logit and winsorization).

work/build.sas: lines 22-23 (Compustat support window), 73 (dated names bound), 198-202 and 229 (dated security rows and event-year join), 277 (FX bound), 373-380 (first qualified event selection), 389-430 (eight-year TS and year/SIC2 CS estimates), 816 and 869-870 (FYEAR retained through SAS handoff).

work/stata.ipynb cell table7_ts_jones: accepted unweighted logit and e(sample)-based counts; work/runtime/20261118T081944086007Z/cell_table7_ts_jones.log contains the native standalone marker EXT_SAMPLE s1 950 12 2002.
Original saved A2 result: output/reproductions/packages/W3121620818/attempt_02/table7_ts_jones.csv; current aggregate result: work/artifacts/s1.csv.
analyses.count_unit: Matched event-year firm observations: one qualified case or one matched clean control per row; firms may recur in different event years.

comparison.measure: Unstandardized log-odds coefficient on the model-specific absolute discretionary-accrual measure abs(DA), per one-unit increase; p-values follow the two-sided Stata table template.
comparison.precision: Coefficients and p-values shown at the original table export precision (three decimals); odds ratios are from the saved aggregate table.
